description: Perceptual equivalence calibration set (paper Section 2.3): 10 prompts x 4 reference operations = 40 calibration images. Twelve raters complete a constant-stimulus, five-option forced-choice task; the 40 images are excluded from the main analysis.
note: Option sets are equally spaced and bracket the expected match value; the set is shifted for each reference operation. Only the SD three-layer option set (1.10/1.25/1.40/1.55/1.70) is quoted verbatim in the paper; the other three are reconstructed with the same spacing convention.
